generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's decurrent tree species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), family 62 Fagaceae, under which he kept Nothofagus (APG's Nothofagaceae): trees; leaves simple, pinnately veined, with stipules soon falling; flowers unisexual on the same tree, a calyx and no petals; the female in a cup of scales; fruit small nuts in that cup.
